Container.Name: completist
Container.Overview: The ROM library manager that tells you what's missing. Completist compares your ROMs with the No-Intro DATs and shows, system by system, what you have, what is missing and which files are damaged, duplicated or unknown. Count complete sets your way: one version of each game, every official release or the whole DAT. Box art, live tasks, user accounts. Use it with backups of games you own; no games are included or downloaded.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: rom roms retro no-intro dat collection nes snes gba mega drive romm

Config.Name: ROMs
Config.Description: Share with your ROMs, e.g. /mnt/user/roms. Subfolders named after a system (snes, megadrive...) help. Use ro to keep it read only.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that runs the app; 99 is nobody, the owner of Unraid shares.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that runs the app; 100 is users.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for dates and scheduled scans.

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: Optional: an administrator, with the password below. Users can also be created in the app.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional: password of the administrator above.

Config.Name: Allow remote access without login
Config.Description: Optional: true only if another service (a proxy with its own login, a VPN) protects the app. Without users the app otherwise only answers on the local network.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional: cloudflare when Cloudflare connects to the app directly, or proxy addresses separated by commas, so the login protection sees the real visitor address.
